title: Joystick

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Human interface device with multiple outputs for each axis

body:
"Has four output signals, which can go up to 10.0 depending on how close the joystick is to that direction."

The Joystick is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It is a joystick with outputs for both axes.

Functionality

The Joystick's ball can be clicked on to drag the joystick with; releasing one's grip on the joystick causes it to return to center. As the Joystick moves, it emits a signal from its four ports depending on the direction the joystick is moved in. As there are only positive values in Oaklands's logic system, there is a port for both the positive and negative parts of each axis. Each of these ports can output any signal level between 0 and 10 in steps of 1 depending on where the joystick is positioned. The Joystick inherits the color of the first wire that is attached to any of its output ports.
